PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY ISSUES PUBLICLY.

Report them privately through
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/TCWuraGroupCapital/Luminara-CRM/security/advisories/new)
or by email to **security@luminaradigital.com**. See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md)
for what to include and how we respond.
